metadata.scale_note: Node approximately 1 cm long; modeled follicles about 0.8–1.2 mm in major diameter before deformation. Vessel, valve, fibre and cell dimensions are selectively exaggerated for clarity; colors identify compartments rather than histological stains.

01 Whole node — outside.note: Identify convex entry sites and the concave hilar exit. Lymph enters through afferent lymphatics; blood enters and leaves separately at the hilum.

02 Open node — compartments.note: The standard corner cut reveals capsule, subcapsular sinus, follicular outer cortex, deeper paracortex and medulla. Primary follicles lack a germinal centre; secondary follicles contain light/dark zones inside a mantle. Zonal boundaries are illustrative, not histological partitions.

03 Lymph route.note: Trace afferent lymph to subcapsular sinus, cortical/trabecular sinuses, medullary sinuses and efferent lymphatic. Pale blue geometry denotes lymph-filled spaces, not a solid blue tissue. Hidden cortex and cords remain biologically present.

04 Follicles and germinal centres.note: Compare primary follicles with secondary follicles. The light zone faces the subcapsular side, while the dark zone is deeper toward the T-cell zone. Proliferation/mutation and antigen/T-cell-help selection form a cycle rather than a one-pass chain.

05 Blood entry through HEVs.note: Lymphocytes can enter nodal tissue from blood through high endothelial venules in the paracortex. Tall venular endothelium distinguishes HEVs from lymph-filled sinuses. The source does not supply a complete continuous capillary network; do not imply perfusion proof.

06 Cords beside sinuses.note: Medullary cords contain immune cells, including antibody-secreting plasma cells; lymph flows through adjacent sinuses toward the hilum. Macrophages and reticular fibres are representative solid structures within the sinus domain, not defects to remove.

07 Sinus support and macrophages.note: Inspect the representative reticular mesh and macrophages in sinus context. The meshes exaggerate visibility and do not model all sinus endothelium, subcapsular floor macrophage networks, antigen transfer or cortical conduit sheaths.

preserve_cutaway: Existing x/z corner cut, at original zero offsets; no geometry translation or rank separation. Each preset uses assembled state.

native_application.after_viewer: Use ModelView.set_named_view(view_name); native controls apply camera, exact-key hidden list and cut_on.
native_application.summary_note: Camera.note is an archival teaching caption; native code does not display it automatically. Use purpose text in a lesson or model-specific teaching documentation.

deferred_checks: Native review at desktop and smaller-window aspect ratios; labels readable without overlaps.
Corner-cut face readability, especially cortical/medullary interfaces and capsule entry.
Exact part survival and saved-state consistency after reopen; source checks do not certify either.
